{"content":"# Melt the DataFrame from wide to long format
# Keep 'user' and 'someBool' as identifier variables
# Unpivot the date columns '01/12/15' and '02/12/15'

             value_vars=['01/12/15', '02/12/15'],
             var_name='date', 
             value_name='value')

# Drop rows where value is NaN (missing values)
df = df.dropna(subset=['value'])

# Sort by user and date for the desired output order
df = df.sort_values(['user', 'date'])

# Reset index to get clean integer index
df = df.reset_index(drop=True)","path":"solution.py"}
